remote_user.description: The username on the remote SSH server.

remote_host.description: The hostname or IP address of the remote SSH server.

remote_dir.description: The remote directory path to mount. Defaults to user home.

local_mount_point.description: The local directory where the remote filesystem will be mounted.

mount_options.description: List of SSHFS and FUSE mount options. Common options include allow_other, default_permissions, reconnect, and SSH keep-alive settings.
